name: RPTKA approval and DKPTKA payment for a foreign worker

rules.description: Before a foreign worker starts, hold the approved RPTKA and pay the DKPTKA compensation fund for the period worked in Indonesia. Raised for a hire whose nationality is not ID (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2).
rules.authority: PP 34/2021 arts.1 angka 7, 23 (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161898/pp-no-34-tahun-2021)

Not raised for a part-time or daily worker (pegawai tidak tetap), who has the monthly bukti potong (PPH21_BUKTI_POTONG).
rules.authority: PER-11/PJ/2025 art.7(2) (https://jdih.kemenkeu.go.id/dok/per-11pj2025); PMK 168/2023 art.13

rules.authority: Permenaker 2/2025 art.9 (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/2025pmnaker002.pdf); PP 37/2021 art.20 as amended by PP 6/2025

name: Report of a termination of employment

rules.description: Report the termination to the ministry and the provincial/regency manpower office once the worker received the notice and did not reject it. Raised for an employer-initiated termination cause (not a resignation or death).
rules.authority: PP 35/2021 art.38 (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP352021.pdf)
rules.when: contract != null && contract.exit_facts != null && contract.effective_range.to != null

rules.description: Report the company's employment data to the manpower ministry (Wajib Lapor Ketenagakerjaan di Perusahaan, online) within 30 days of establishing, reopening or moving the company. Raised when the entity is created; the due day counts from the first day of that month, never later than the deadline. The annual report thereafter is not raised (its anniversary is not on the duty context).
rules.authority: UU 7/1981 arts.6, 8 (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/47039/uu-no-7-tahun-1981); Permenaker 18/2017 as amended by Permenaker 4/2019

name: Wage at least the workplace minimum wage

rules.when: term.employment_type in ["PERMANENT", "CONTRACT"] && !(has(company.facts.enterprise_size_class) && company.facts.enterprise_size_class == "MICRO_OR_SMALL") && ((has(terms.facts.worksite_region) && terms.facts.worksite_region != "" ? terms.facts.worksite_region : company.region) in rules.minimum_wage.by_region) && term.monthly_wage < rules.minimum_wage.by_region[(has(terms.facts.worksite_region) && terms.facts.worksite_region != "" ? terms.facts.worksite_region : company.region)] && employment.service_months < 12.0
rules.message: The monthly wage (basic plus fixed allowances; where the wage is basic plus non-fixed allowances, the basic alone) of a worker with less than one year of service is below the minimum wage of the worksite (terms.facts.worksite_region, else the company region); UU 13/2003 art.88E bars paying less.
rules.authority: UU 13/2003 art.88E(1)–(2) as amended by UU 6/2023; PP 36/2021 arts.23(1)–(3), 24(1), 25 as amended by PP 51/2023 and PP 49/2025 (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021) — the UMK of the worksite, else the UMP; art.23(2): where the wage is basic plus non-fixed allowances the basic alone must reach it (`terms.monthly_wage` holds only basic plus fixed allowances). Art.24(1): the minimum binds a worker with less than one year of service; longer service follows the wage structure and scale (art.24(2)). Micro and small enterprises are outside it (art.36). Daily and hourly wages are DAILY_MINIMUM_WAGE and HOURLY_MINIMUM_WAGE.

name: Basic wage at least 75% of basic plus fixed allowances

rules.when: term.monthly_wage > 0.0 && term.base_salary < 0.75 * term.monthly_wage
rules.message: The basic wage is below 75% of basic wage plus fixed allowances (PP 36/2021 art.7(2)).
rules.authority: PP 36/2021 art.7(2): where the wage is basic plus fixed allowances, the basic wage is at least 75% of the total of basic wage and fixed allowances (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021).

name: Overtime at most 4 hours a day

rules.when: work.days.exists(d, (d.day_type == "WORK" || d.day_type == "") && d.holiday_kind == "" && d.overtime_hours > 4.0)
rules.message: Overtime above 4 hours on a working day (PP 35/2021 art.26(1)); the hours are paid, the limit is breached.
rules.authority: PP 35/2021 art.26(1)–(2): overtime at most 4 hours a day and 18 hours a week, not counting overtime on the weekly rest day or an official holiday (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP352021.pdf). The hours worked are still paid (art.31), so the run warns rather than refuses.

name: Overtime at most 18 hours a week

rules.when: work.days.exists(d, sum(work.days.filter(x, (x.day_type == "WORK" || x.day_type == "") && x.holiday_kind == "" && calendar_distance_days(x.date, d.date) >= 0.0 && calendar_distance_days(x.date, d.date) <= 6.0).map(x, x.overtime_hours)) > 18.0)
rules.message: Overtime above 18 hours in seven consecutive days (PP 35/2021 art.26(1)); the hours are paid, the limit is breached.
rules.authority: PP 35/2021 art.26(1)–(2) (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP352021.pdf). The week is read as any seven consecutive days of the attendance window, which never misses a calendar week over the limit; rest-day and holiday overtime is outside the limit (art.26(2)).

name: Wage deductions at most 50% of the wage paid

rules.when: payslip.gross + (has(payslip.lines.CLAWBACK_OVERTIME) ? -payslip.lines.CLAWBACK_OVERTIME : 0.0) > 0.0 && (has(payslip.lines.STAFF_LOAN) ? -payslip.lines.STAFF_LOAN : 0.0) + (has(payslip.lines.DEDUCTION) ? -payslip.lines.DEDUCTION : 0.0) + (has(payslip.lines.PKWT_EARLY_TERMINATION_BY_WORKER) ? -payslip.lines.PKWT_EARLY_TERMINATION_BY_WORKER : 0.0) + (has(payslip.lines.CLAWBACK_OVERTIME) ? -payslip.lines.CLAWBACK_OVERTIME : 0.0) > 0.5 * (payslip.gross + (has(payslip.lines.CLAWBACK_OVERTIME) ? -payslip.lines.CLAWBACK_OVERTIME : 0.0))
rules.message: Loan instalments, deductions, art.62 damages and recovered overpayments exceed 50% of this wage payment (PP 36/2021 art.65); the payslip is held.
rules.authority: PP 36/2021 arts.63–65: fines, damages, wage advances, rent, debts and their instalments, and recovered overpaid wages may together take at most 50% of each wage payment (art.65); contributions to the state and social security (BPJS, PPh 21) are outside it (art.64), and so is the pension offset against separation pay (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021). Here: STAFF_LOAN, DEDUCTION and CLAWBACK_OVERTIME against the gross before the clawback. The UU 13/2003 art.62 damages a resigning PKWT worker owes (PKWT_EARLY_TERMINATION_BY_WORKER) are damages within the same 50%.

rules.description: Report the company's employment data to the manpower ministry (WLKP online) every year, on the anniversary of its first report (`company.facts.wlkp_first_reported_on`). Raised once a year with that month's payroll run (one per company); a company without the date recorded raises nothing — record it.
rules.authority: UU 7/1981 art.8(1): the report is repeated every year (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/47039/uu-no-7-tahun-1981); Permenaker 18/2017 as amended by Permenaker 4/2019
rules.when: has(company.facts.wlkp_first_reported_on) && months_through(company.facts.wlkp_first_reported_on, period.from) > 1.0 && int(months_through(company.facts.wlkp_first_reported_on, period.from) - 1.0) % 12 == 0

name: Work accident report to BPJS Ketenagakerjaan (stage I)

rules.description: Report a work accident or occupational disease to BPJS Ketenagakerjaan and the manpower office within 2 × 24 hours of it (stage I). Raised when a WORK_ACCIDENT_LEAVE absence is recorded, counted from its first day; stage II is WORK_ACCIDENT_REPORT_STAGE2.
rules.authority: PP 44/2015 art.43 (https://www.bpjsketenagakerjaan.go.id/assets/uploads/peraturan/15122015_104557_PP%2044%20Tahun%202015.pdf); UU 24/2011 art.15
rules.when: row.catalog_code == "WORK_ACCIDENT_LEAVE"

name: Renewal of the company regulations (Peraturan Perusahaan)

rules.description: An employer of 10 or more workers must have company regulations ratified by the minister or official; they are valid for at most 2 years and must be renewed. Raised with the payroll run of the month the recorded validity ends (`company.facts.company_regulation_valid_until`), for a company of 10 or more workers.
rules.authority: UU 13/2003 arts.108(1), 111(3) (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan/detail/27/undang-undang-nomor-13-tahun-2003); Permenaker 28/2014

rules.description: Overtime needs the employer's order and the worker's written or digital consent, and the employer keeps a list of the overtime worked (art.28). Raised when an attendance day is created or updated carrying approved overtime hours with no recorded consent (`overtime_consented_at`), due that day; meals of 1,400 kcal for 4 hours or more (art.29(1)(c)) are not tracked.
rules.authority: PP 35/2021 arts.28–29 (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP352021.pdf)
rules.when: has(row.approved_overtime_hours) && row.approved_overtime_hours != null && row.approved_overtime_hours > 0.0 && (!has(row.overtime_consented_at) || row.overtime_consented_at == null)

rules.description: Pay the religious holiday allowance (THR) at the latest 7 days before each worker’s own religious holiday — Idul Fitri (Islam), Christmas / Kelahiran Yesus Kristus (Catholic and Protestant), Nyepi (Hindu), Waisak (Buddhist), Imlek (Konghucu); a late THR carries a 5% fine (LATE_THR_FINE). Raised with the payroll run of the month the 7-day deadline falls in, from the company’s published holidays (by name, Indonesian SKB names or English); waive it where no worker’s holiday is the one named.
rules.authority: Permenaker 6/2016 arts.1(2), 2, 5(1), 5(4), 10 (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/permenaker_6_2016.pdf); PP 36/2021 art.62
rules.when: holidays_named.exists(h, h.kind == "PUBLIC_HOLIDAY" && ["Idul Fitri", "Idulfitri", "Eid al-Fitr", "Natal", "Kelahiran Yesus Kristus", "Christmas", "Nyepi", "Waisak", "Vesak", "Imlek", "Chinese New Year"].exists(k, h.name.contains(k)) && add_days(h.date, -7) >= period.from && add_days(h.date, -7) <= period.to)
rules.due: add_days(first(holidays_named.filter(h, h.kind == "PUBLIC_HOLIDAY" && ["Idul Fitri", "Idulfitri", "Eid al-Fitr", "Natal", "Kelahiran Yesus Kristus", "Christmas", "Nyepi", "Waisak", "Vesak", "Imlek", "Chinese New Year"].exists(k, h.name.contains(k)) && add_days(h.date, -7) >= period.from)).date, -7)

name: Sector minimum wage at least the governor's UMSP

rules.when: term.employment_type in ["PERMANENT", "CONTRACT"] && !(has(company.facts.enterprise_size_class) && company.facts.enterprise_size_class == "MICRO_OR_SMALL") && employment.service_months < 12.0 && has(rules.minimum_wage.by_sector) && has(term.facts.worksite_kbli) && rules.minimum_wage.by_sector.exists(k, ((has(terms.facts.worksite_region) && terms.facts.worksite_region != "" ? terms.facts.worksite_region : company.region) == k || (has(terms.facts.worksite_region) && terms.facts.worksite_region != "" ? terms.facts.worksite_region : company.region).startsWith(k + "/")) && rules.minimum_wage.by_sector[k].exists(r, term.facts.worksite_kbli.startsWith(r.kbli) && (r.condition == "" || (r.condition == "RAYON_VISCOSE" && has(company.facts.umsp_rayon_viscose) && company.facts.umsp_rayon_viscose == true) || (r.condition == "EXPORT" && (has(company.facts.umsp_export_oriented) && company.facts.umsp_export_oriented == true)) || (r.condition == "ASSETS_1T" && (has(company.facts.umsp_assets_over_1_trillion) && company.facts.umsp_assets_over_1_trillion == true)) || (r.condition == "ASTRA" && (has(company.facts.umsp_astra_group) && company.facts.umsp_astra_group == true)) || (r.condition == "HOTEL_4_5" && has(company.facts.umsp_hotel_star) && company.facts.umsp_hotel_star >= 4.0) || (r.condition == "HOTEL_3_5" && has(company.facts.umsp_hotel_star) && company.facts.umsp_hotel_star >= 3.0) || (r.condition == "FREEPORT_AREA" && has(company.facts.umsp_freeport_area) && company.facts.umsp_freeport_area == true) || (r.condition == "BUS_DRIVER_MECHANIC" && (has(term.facts.umsp_job_category) ? term.facts.umsp_job_category : "") == "BUS_DRIVER_MECHANIC") || (r.condition == "CLASS_A_HOSPITAL_CARE" && (has(company.facts.umsp_class_a_private_hospital) && company.facts.umsp_class_a_private_hospital == true) && (has(term.facts.umsp_job_category) ? term.facts.umsp_job_category : "") in ["NURSING_MIDWIFERY", "MEDICAL_SUPPORT"])) && term.monthly_wage < r.monthly))
rules.message: The monthly wage is below the governor’s sector minimum wage for this worksite’s KBLI (rules.minimum_wage.by_sector: a KBLI code or a group prefix, of the worksite’s province or locality); a worker with less than one year of service may not be paid less.

Row conditions are customer inputs: exporter, assets above Rp1 trillion, Astra group, star hotel (4–5 or 3–5 stars), class-A private hospital, rayon-viscose staple fibre, work in the PT Freeport Indonesia area (company.facts), and the job category for the DKI bus and hospital rows (terms.facts.umsp_job_category); the worksite is terms.facts.worksite_region, else the company region.

rules.description: Pay the DKPTKA, USD 100 per foreign worker per month, in advance: the month’s charge falls due on its first day.
rules.authority: PP 34/2021 arts.1 angka 7, 6–7 (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP342021.pdf); USD 100 per position per month, paid in advance (Kemnaker PNBP tariff, as PP 34/2021 applies it; secondary)

rules.description: Make and give each recipient paid in the month the monthly withholding slip (BPMP for a permanent employee, BP21 for a non-permanent one, BP26), including a nil withholding and the DTP incentive, by the end of the month the tax is owed.

name: Late wage: fine owed to the worker

rules.description: A wage paid on or after the 4th day counted from its due day (the due day being day 1) carries a fine to the worker (LATE_WAGE_FINE adhoc class): 5% a day from the 4th to the 8th day, then 1% more a day, at most 50% in a month, plus interest after a month; the wage stays due. Raised when a payslip is marked paid on or after that 4th day.
rules.authority: PP 36/2021 arts.55(1), 61(1)–(2) (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021)
rules.when: has(row.paid_on) && row.paid_on != null && has(row.pay_due_date) && row.pay_due_date != null && row.pay_due_date != "" && row.paid_on >= add_days(row.pay_due_date, 3)

rules.description: A THR paid later than 7 days before the holiday carries a fine of 5% of the THR due, used for the workers’ welfare (LATE_THR_FINE adhoc class); the THR stays due. Raised when a THR entry is recorded after the deadline.
rules.when: has(row.catalog_code) && row.catalog_code in ["THR", "THR_HOLIDAY"] && has(row.facts) && row.facts != null && has(row.facts.holiday_date) && row.occurred_on > add_days(row.facts.holiday_date, -7)

name: PKWT period ended: pay its compensation

rules.description: A fixed-term (PKWT) period that ends while the employment continues (an extension follows) owes its uang kompensasi at its end, for that period; the extension’s compensation follows when it ends. Raised by the daily tick on the last day of a CONTRACT term that is not the exit day; pay it as a PKWT_COMPENSATION entry.
rules.authority: PP 35/2021 arts.15(2), 15(4), 16 (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP352021.pdf)

rules.message: Record the worksite (terms.facts.worksite_region, else the company region) as a key of the version’s minimum wages: “Provinsi X/Kota|Kabupaten Y” — every locality is listed, at its UMK or at the UMP — or “Provinsi DKI Jakarta”. A province key whose localities are listed, or an unknown key, cannot fall back to the lower UMP.
rules.authority: UU 13/2003 art.88E(2) as amended by UU 6/2023; PP 36/2021 art.25 (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021); Perpres 82/2018 art.32(2)–(3)

rules.when: term.employment_type == "DAILY" && !(has(company.facts.enterprise_size_class) && company.facts.enterprise_size_class == "MICRO_OR_SMALL") && ((has(terms.facts.worksite_region) && terms.facts.worksite_region != "" ? terms.facts.worksite_region : company.region) in rules.minimum_wage.by_region) && employment.service_months < 12.0 && (!has(terms.facts.working_days_per_week) || !has(terms.facts.daily_wage) || terms.facts.daily_wage < rules.minimum_wage.by_region[(has(terms.facts.worksite_region) && terms.facts.worksite_region != "" ? terms.facts.worksite_region : company.region)] / ((has(terms.facts.working_days_per_week) && terms.facts.working_days_per_week == 6.0) ? 25.0 : 21.0))
rules.message: Record the daily wage and the working days a week of a daily worker; the daily wage may not be below the monthly minimum wage ÷ 25 (6-day week) or ÷ 21 (5-day week).
rules.authority: PP 36/2021 arts.17, 23(3) (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021); UU 13/2003 art.88E(2) as amended by UU 6/2023

rules.when: term.employment_type == "PART_TIME" && !(has(company.facts.enterprise_size_class) && company.facts.enterprise_size_class == "MICRO_OR_SMALL") && ((has(terms.facts.worksite_region) && terms.facts.worksite_region != "" ? terms.facts.worksite_region : company.region) in rules.minimum_wage.by_region) && employment.service_months < 12.0 && has(terms.facts.hourly_wage) && terms.facts.hourly_wage < rules.minimum_wage.by_region[(has(terms.facts.worksite_region) && terms.facts.worksite_region != "" ? terms.facts.worksite_region : company.region)] / 126.0
rules.message: The agreed hourly wage of a part-time worker may not be below the monthly minimum wage ÷ 126.
rules.authority: PP 36/2021 art.16(1)–(4) (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021)

rules.when: term.employment_type == "CONTRACT" && employment.start_date != "" && ((terms.effective_to != "" && terms.effective_to > add_days(add_years(employment.start_date, 5), -1)) || (employment.exit_date != "" && employment.exit_date > add_days(add_years(employment.start_date, 5), -1)))
rules.message: A time-based PKWT, extensions included, may not run longer than 5 years from the start of the fixed-term employment; beyond that it is a PKWTT.
rules.authority: PP 35/2021 art.8(1)–(3) (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP352021.pdf); UU 13/2003 art.59 as amended by UU 6/2023

name: Probation: none in a PKWT, at most 3 months

rules.when: has(terms.facts.probation_months) && terms.facts.probation_months > 0.0 && (term.employment_type in ["CONTRACT", "DAILY"] || terms.facts.probation_months > 3.0)
rules.message: A PKWT may not require a probation period (it is void); a PKWTT probation is at most 3 months, paid at least the minimum wage.
rules.authority: UU 13/2003 arts.58(1)–(2), 60(1)–(2) (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan/detail/27/undang-undang-nomor-13-tahun-2003), as amended by UU 6/2023

rules.when: term.employment_type in ["CONTRACT", "DAILY"] && has(terms.facts.written_in_indonesian) && terms.facts.written_in_indonesian == false
rules.message: A PKWT (a daily one included) must be made in writing in Indonesian, in Latin script.
rules.authority: UU 13/2003 art.57(1) as amended by UU 6/2023; PP 35/2021 arts.2, 11(1) (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP352021.pdf)

name: No foreign worker in a personnel position

rules.when: (employee.nationality != "" && employee.nationality != "ID") && has(terms.facts.personnel_position) && terms.facts.personnel_position == true
rules.message: A foreign worker may not be employed in a position that handles personnel (HR).
rules.authority: PP 34/2021 art.11(1) (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP342021.pdf)

rules.when: employee.date_of_birth != "" && double(age_on(employee.date_of_birth, day)) < 13.0
rules.message: A child under 13 may not be employed; from 13 to 15 only light work under art.69, from 14 within education under art.70.
rules.authority: UU 13/2003 arts.68–70 (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan/detail/27/undang-undang-nomor-13-tahun-2003)

rules.when: (employee.nationality != "" && employee.nationality != "ID") && terms.employment_type != "CONTRACT"
rules.message: A foreign worker may be employed only for a certain position and a certain time (PKWT); this term is not a PKWT.
rules.authority: UU 13/2003 art.42(4) as amended by UU 6/2023 (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan/detail/27/undang-undang-nomor-13-tahun-2003); PP 34/2021 art.2

name: Ordinary working time 7/8 hours a day, 40 a week

rules.when: work.days.exists(d, d.scheduled_hours > ((has(terms.facts.working_days_per_week) && terms.facts.working_days_per_week == 6.0) ? 7.0 : 8.0)) || work.days.exists(d, sum(work.days.filter(x, calendar_distance_days(x.date, d.date) >= 0.0 && calendar_distance_days(x.date, d.date) <= 6.0).map(x, x.scheduled_hours)) > 40.0)
rules.message: Ordinary working time above 7 hours a day (6-day week) or 8 (5-day week), or above 40 hours in seven consecutive days; hours beyond it are overtime.
rules.authority: PP 35/2021 art.21(2)–(3) (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP352021.pdf); UU 13/2003 art.77 as amended by UU 6/2023

name: Weekly rest: 1 day (6-day week), 2 days (5-day week)

rules.when: work.days.exists(d, double(size(work.days.filter(x, x.worked && calendar_distance_days(x.date, d.date) >= 0.0 && calendar_distance_days(x.date, d.date) <= 6.0))) > ((has(terms.facts.working_days_per_week) && terms.facts.working_days_per_week == 6.0) ? 6.0 : 5.0))
rules.message: Fewer weekly rest days in seven consecutive days than the working-time system gives (1 for a 6-day week, 2 for a 5-day week); work on a rest day is overtime with a written order and consent.
rules.authority: PP 35/2021 art.22 (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP352021.pdf); UU 13/2003 art.79(2)(b) as amended by UU 6/2023 and read by Putusan MK 168/PUU-XXI/2023

rules.when: employee.gender == "FEMALE" && employee.date_of_birth != "" && work.days.exists(d, double(age_on(employee.date_of_birth, d.date)) < 18.0 && hours_between(d.intervals, "23:00", "07:00") > 0.0)
rules.message: A female worker under 18 may not work between 23:00 and 07:00; the payslip is held.
rules.authority: UU 13/2003 art.76(1) (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan/detail/27/undang-undang-nomor-13-tahun-2003)

rules.when: employee.gender == "FEMALE" && has(employee.facts.night_work_pregnancy_risk) && employee.facts.night_work_pregnancy_risk == true && work.days.exists(d, hours_between(d.intervals, "23:00", "07:00") > 0.0)
rules.message: A pregnant worker whom a doctor certifies at risk may not work between 23:00 and 07:00; the payslip is held.
rules.authority: UU 13/2003 art.76(2) (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan/detail/27/undang-undang-nomor-13-tahun-2003)

name: Night work by women: food, security and transport

rules.when: employee.gender == "FEMALE" && work.days.exists(d, hours_between(d.intervals, "23:00", "07:00") > 0.0)
rules.message: A female worker worked between 23:00 and 07:00: provide nutritious food and drink and keep decency and security at work; between 23:00 and 05:00 provide transport to and from work.
rules.authority: UU 13/2003 art.76(3)–(4) (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan/detail/27/undang-undang-nomor-13-tahun-2003)

rules.when: employee.date_of_birth != "" && work.days.exists(d, d.worked && double(age_on(employee.date_of_birth, d.date)) < 18.0)
rules.message: A worker under 18 worked: lawful only as light work (13–15, with parental consent, at most 3 hours, by day, outside school hours), within education (14 and over) or talent work.
rules.authority: UU 13/2003 arts.68–71 (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan/detail/27/undang-undang-nomor-13-tahun-2003)

name: Light work above 3 hours or by night (13–15)

rules.when: employee.date_of_birth != "" && work.days.exists(d, double(age_on(employee.date_of_birth, d.date)) < 15.0 && (d.worked_hours > 3.0 || hours_between(d.intervals, "23:00", "07:00") > 0.0))
rules.message: A child under 15 may do light work for at most 3 hours a day, by day; the payslip is held.
rules.authority: UU 13/2003 art.69(2) (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan/detail/27/undang-undang-nomor-13-tahun-2003)

name: Daily worker on 21 days or more

rules.when: terms.employment_type == "DAILY" && double(size(work.days.filter(d, d.worked))) >= 21.0
rules.message: A daily worker worked 21 days or more this month; three such months in a row turn the daily agreement into a PKWTT by law (severance and THR follow).
rules.authority: PP 35/2021 art.10(3)–(4) (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP352021.pdf)

rules.when: has(payslip.lines.COURT_GARNISHMENT) && -payslip.lines.COURT_GARNISHMENT > 0.2 * payslip.gross
rules.message: A court-ordered seizure of wages may not exceed 20% of the wage payable; the payslip is held.
rules.authority: PP 36/2021 art.51 (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021)

rules.when: has(payslip.lines.BANKRUPTCY_ESTATE) && -payslip.lines.BANKRUPTCY_ESTATE > 0.25 * payslip.gross
rules.message: Where the worker is bankrupt, the court may take at most 25% of the wage and other payments of the employment; the payslip is held.
rules.authority: PP 36/2021 art.50 (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021)

rules.when: day.worked && (day.day_type == "WORK" || day.day_type == "") && day.holiday_kind == "" && day.worked_hours - day.overtime_hours > ((has(terms.facts.working_days_per_week) && terms.facts.working_days_per_week == 6.0) ? 7.0 : 8.0)
rules.message: normal hours above 7 in the day on a six-day week (8 on a five-day week) (PP 35/2021 art.21(2)).
rules.description: normal hours above 7 in the day on a six-day week (8 on a five-day week) (PP 35/2021 art.21(2)).
rules.authority: PP 35/2021 art.21(2): 7 hours a day and 40 a week over six days, or 8 hours a day and 40 a week over five (term fact working_days_per_week); UU 13/2003 art.77 as amended by UU 6/2023. PP 35/2021 (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP352021.pdf)

rules.when: week.worked_hours - week.overtime_hours > 40.0
rules.message: normal hours above 40 in the seven days ending on this day (PP 35/2021 art.21(2)).
rules.description: normal hours above 40 in the seven days ending on this day (PP 35/2021 art.21(2)).
rules.authority: PP 35/2021 art.21(2): 40 normal hours a week. PP 35/2021 (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP352021.pdf)

rules.when: (day.day_type == "WORK" || day.day_type == "") && day.holiday_kind == "" && day.overtime_hours > 4.0
rules.message: more than 4 overtime hours on a working day (PP 35/2021 art.26(1)).
rules.description: more than 4 overtime hours on a working day (PP 35/2021 art.26(1)).
rules.authority: PP 35/2021 art.26(1)–(2): overtime at most 4 hours a day and 18 a week, rest-day and holiday overtime outside the limit; the hours worked are still paid (art.31), so the import warns. PP 35/2021 (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP352021.pdf)

rules.when: (day.day_type == "WORK" || day.day_type == "") && day.holiday_kind == "" && day.overtime_hours > 0.0 && max(0.0, week.overtime_hours_by_day_type.WORK - week.overtime_hours_by_day_type.HOLIDAY) > 18.0
rules.message: more than 18 overtime hours on working days in the seven days ending on this working day (PP 35/2021 art.26(1)).
rules.description: more than 18 overtime hours on working days in the seven days ending on this working day (PP 35/2021 art.26(1)).
rules.authority: PP 35/2021 art.26(1)–(2): at most 18 overtime hours a week; overtime on the weekly rest day or an official holiday is outside the limit, so only overtime on planned working days that are not holidays counts (week.overtime_hours_by_day_type WORK less HOLIDAY). PP 35/2021 (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP352021.pdf)

rules.when: day.worked && double(week.worked_days) > ((has(terms.facts.working_days_per_week) && terms.facts.working_days_per_week == 6.0) ? 6.0 : 5.0)
rules.message: no weekly rest day in the seven days ending on this day (UU 13/2003 art.79(2)(b); PP 35/2021 art.22).
rules.description: no weekly rest day in the seven days ending on this day (UU 13/2003 art.79(2)(b); PP 35/2021 art.22).
rules.authority: UU 13/2003 art.79(2)(b) as amended by UU 6/2023: one rest day after six working days a week (Putusan MK 168/PUU-XXI/2023 restores two after five on a five-day week); PP 35/2021 art.22. UU 13/2003 (https://jdih.kemenkeu.go.id/api/download/fulltext/2003/13TAHUN2003UU.htm)

rules.when: employee.gender == "FEMALE" && employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && double(age_on(employee.date_of_birth, day.date)) < 18.0 && hours_between(day.intervals, "23:00", "07:00") > 0.0
rules.message: a woman under 18 worked between 23:00 and 07:00 (UU 13/2003 art.76(1)).
rules.description: a woman under 18 worked between 23:00 and 07:00 (UU 13/2003 art.76(1)).
rules.authority: UU 13/2003 art.76(1): a female worker under 18 may not be employed between 23:00 and 07:00. UU 13/2003 (https://jdih.kemenkeu.go.id/api/download/fulltext/2003/13TAHUN2003UU.htm)

rules.when: employee.gender == "FEMALE" && has(employee.facts.night_work_pregnancy_risk) && employee.facts.night_work_pregnancy_risk == true && hours_between(day.intervals, "23:00", "07:00") > 0.0
rules.message: night work (23:00–07:00) by a pregnant worker whom a doctor declared at risk (UU 13/2003 art.76(2)).
rules.description: night work (23:00–07:00) by a pregnant worker whom a doctor declared at risk (UU 13/2003 art.76(2)).
rules.authority: UU 13/2003 art.76(2): a pregnant worker whom a doctor certifies at risk to her or her pregnancy may not work between 23:00 and 07:00 (employee.facts.night_work_pregnancy_risk). UU 13/2003 (https://jdih.kemenkeu.go.id/api/download/fulltext/2003/13TAHUN2003UU.htm)

rules.when: employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && day.worked && double(age_on(employee.date_of_birth, day.date)) >= 13.0 && double(age_on(employee.date_of_birth, day.date)) < 15.0 && (day.worked_hours > 3.0 || hours_between(day.intervals, "23:00", "07:00") > 0.0)
rules.message: a child of 13 to 15 above 3 hours of light work in the day, or at night (UU 13/2003 art.69(2)).
rules.description: a child of 13 to 15 above 3 hours of light work in the day, or at night (UU 13/2003 art.69(2)).
rules.authority: UU 13/2003 art.69(1)–(2): a child of 13 to 15 does light work only, at most 3 hours a day, in the daytime, with the parent’s written permission. UU 13/2003 (https://jdih.kemenkeu.go.id/api/download/fulltext/2003/13TAHUN2003UU.htm)

rules.when: employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && day.worked && double(age_on(employee.date_of_birth, day.date)) < 13.0
rules.message: a child under 13 may not be employed (UU 13/2003 arts.68–69): remove the day.
rules.description: a child under 13 may not be employed (UU 13/2003 arts.68–69): remove the day.
rules.authority: UU 13/2003 art.68: employers may not employ children; art.69 allows light work from 13 to 15 only. The contract site refuses the same (MINIMUM_AGE). UU 13/2003 (https://jdih.kemenkeu.go.id/api/download/fulltext/2003/13TAHUN2003UU.htm)

rules.description: Report a change in the worker's wage (basic plus fixed allowances) to BPJS Ketenagakerjaan within 7 working days of the change. Raised on the contract write that adds or changes a term whose wage differs from the term ending the day before — for any effective date, so a term entered late raises too — once per change (repeat_key = the new term's first day); due seven working days after that day (no Saturday, Sunday or published holiday).
rules.authority: PP 44/2015 art.9(3) (https://www.bpjsketenagakerjaan.go.id/assets/uploads/peraturan/15122015_104557_PP%2044%20Tahun%202015.pdf)
rules.when: has(row.terms_written) && row.terms_written.exists(t, has(t.effective_range) && has(t.base_salary) && contract != null && has(contract.facts) && contract.facts != null && has(contract.facts.contract_terms) && contract.facts.contract_terms.exists(p, has(p.effective_range) && has(p.effective_range.to) && p.effective_range.to == add_days(t.effective_range.from, -1) && has(p.base_salary) && (double(p.base_salary.value) + (has(p.allowances) && size(p.allowances) > 0 ? sum(p.allowances.map(a, double(a.amount.value))) : 0.0)) != (double(t.base_salary.value) + (has(t.allowances) && size(t.allowances) > 0 ? sum(t.allowances.map(a, double(a.amount.value))) : 0.0))))
rules.applies_when: (employee == null || !has(employee.nationality) || employee.nationality == "ID" || contract == null || !has(contract.facts) || contract.facts == null || !has(contract.facts.contract_terms) || !contract.facts.contract_terms.exists(t, has(t.facts) && has(t.facts.indonesia_work_months_planned) && t.facts.indonesia_work_months_planned < 6.0))
rules.due: add_working_days(first(row.terms_written.filter(t, has(t.effective_range) && has(t.base_salary) && contract != null && has(contract.facts) && contract.facts != null && has(contract.facts.contract_terms) && contract.facts.contract_terms.exists(p, has(p.effective_range) && has(p.effective_range.to) && p.effective_range.to == add_days(t.effective_range.from, -1) && has(p.base_salary) && (double(p.base_salary.value) + (has(p.allowances) && size(p.allowances) > 0 ? sum(p.allowances.map(a, double(a.amount.value))) : 0.0)) != (double(t.base_salary.value) + (has(t.allowances) && size(t.allowances) > 0 ? sum(t.allowances.map(a, double(a.amount.value))) : 0.0))))).effective_range.from, 7, holidays, ["SATURDAY", "SUNDAY"])
rules.repeat_key: first(row.terms_written.filter(t, has(t.effective_range) && has(t.base_salary) && contract != null && has(contract.facts) && contract.facts != null && has(contract.facts.contract_terms) && contract.facts.contract_terms.exists(p, has(p.effective_range) && has(p.effective_range.to) && p.effective_range.to == add_days(t.effective_range.from, -1) && has(p.base_salary) && (double(p.base_salary.value) + (has(p.allowances) && size(p.allowances) > 0 ? sum(p.allowances.map(a, double(a.amount.value))) : 0.0)) != (double(t.base_salary.value) + (has(t.allowances) && size(t.allowances) > 0 ? sum(t.allowances.map(a, double(a.amount.value))) : 0.0))))).effective_range.from

rules.description: Report the change in the number of workers — the worker leaving — to BPJS Ketenagakerjaan within 7 working days of the exit, whatever the cause (the JKP termination report is JKP_PHK_NOTIFICATION).
rules.authority: PP 44/2015 art.9(3) (https://www.bpjsketenagakerjaan.go.id/assets/uploads/peraturan/15122015_104557_PP%2044%20Tahun%202015.pdf)
rules.when: contract != null && contract.exit_facts != null && contract.effective_range.to != null
rules.applies_when: (employee == null || !has(employee.nationality) || employee.nationality == "ID" || contract == null || !has(contract.facts) || contract.facts == null || !has(contract.facts.contract_terms) || !contract.facts.contract_terms.exists(t, has(t.facts) && has(t.facts.indonesia_work_months_planned) && t.facts.indonesia_work_months_planned < 6.0))

rules.description: Report a change of the employer's own registered data — its name, registration number or the province it is located in (the office address) — to BPJS Ketenagakerjaan within 7 working days of the change. Raised on the entity update that changed one of them (row.before), once per new state; due seven working days after the update.
rules.authority: PP 44/2015 art.9(3) (https://www.bpjsketenagakerjaan.go.id/assets/uploads/peraturan/15122015_104557_PP%2044%20Tahun%202015.pdf)
rules.when: has(row.before) && row.before != null && ("name" in row.before || "registration_number" in row.before || "region" in row.before)
rules.repeat_key: row.name + ":" + (has(row.registration_number) && row.registration_number != null ? row.registration_number : "") + ":" + (has(row.region) && row.region != null ? row.region : "")

rules.description: Keep the books, records and documents of the past year — payroll, withholding slips and returns, including electronically held data — for 10 years in Indonesia, at the taxpayer's seat. Raised on the January run.
rules.authority: UU 6/1983 as amended by UU 28/2007 (KUP) art.28(11) (https://www.pajak.go.id/id/undang-undang-nomor-28-tahun-2007)

kinds.name: Data subject correction or update request (art.30)
Request to suspend or restrict processing (art.41)

rules.description: A failure of personal data protection: notify the data subjects and the supervisory institution in writing within 3 × 24 hours — the data disclosed, when and how, and the handling and recovery steps (art.46(2)). Raised when a PERSONAL_DATA_BREACH case is opened; due three days after its opening day.
rules.authority: UU 27/2022 (Pelindungan Data Pribadi) art.46(1)–(2) (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Download/224884/UU%20Nomor%2027%20Tahun%202022.pdf)
rules.when: row.kind == "PERSONAL_DATA_BREACH"

rules.description: Answer an employee's personal-data request within 3 × 24 hours of receiving it: give access with the processing record (art.32(2)), update or correct the data and tell the employee (art.30), stop processing on a withdrawn consent (art.40(2)), or suspend or restrict processing (art.41(1)). Raised when such a case is opened; due three days after its opening day.
rules.authority: UU 27/2022 arts.30(1)–(2), 32(2), 40(2), 41(1) (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Download/224884/UU%20Nomor%2027%20Tahun%202022.pdf)
rules.when: row.kind in ["PERSONAL_DATA_ACCESS_REQUEST",  "PERSONAL_DATA_CORRECTION_REQUEST",  "PERSONAL_DATA_CONSENT_WITHDRAWAL",  "PERSONAL_DATA_RESTRICTION_REQUEST"]

rules.description: Forward a participant's changed personal or family data (marital status, dependants, children) to BPJS Ketenagakerjaan within 7 working days of receiving it. Raised on a profile update that changed one of them (row.before holds the prior values), once per family state (repeat_key), due 7 working days after the update.
rules.authority: PP 44/2015 art.9(1)–(2) (https://www.bpjsketenagakerjaan.go.id/assets/uploads/peraturan/15122015_104557_PP%2044%20Tahun%202015.pdf)
rules.applies_when: (employee == null || !has(employee.nationality) || employee.nationality == "ID" || contract == null || !has(contract.facts) || contract.facts == null || !has(contract.facts.contract_terms) || !contract.facts.contract_terms.exists(t, has(t.facts) && has(t.facts.indonesia_work_months_planned) && t.facts.indonesia_work_months_planned < 6.0))
rules.repeat_key: (has(employee.marital_status) && employee.marital_status != null ? employee.marital_status : "") + ":" + string(has(employee.dependents_count) && employee.dependents_count != null ? employee.dependents_count : 0) + ":" + string(has(employee.children) && employee.children != null ? size(employee.children) : 0)
